answer: Each identity claims one vertex, burning a 60-credit ferrous bond across three edges, 20 each. A beacon flash each epoch draws edges for proof; a beacon-caught dead edge loses its bond. A shared-vertex ring cramming 1,000 fakes ten per vertex pays 60+30(k-1) each, 195,000 in all; spread apart they pay 60,000 plus 30,000 audit fees, versus a 40,000 prize. One real agent burns a ferrous bond of 60 credits and keeps 10 per clean epoch.
